name: Richard Sisterson
story: The November 2010 NZEUG AGM minutes listed committee members Tony Elson, Marie Slako, Richard Sisterson, Rachel Summers and Richard Wells, with 33 members present at the meeting. The chair reported increased membership, two user meetings that year in Northland and Auckland, and work on rules and policies for awards, regional user groups and committee roles. Under the election item, the executive remained unchanged. The minutes quote rule 6.1 as giving the executive responsibility for appointing non-executive committee members from the membership.
